review.method: Independent source comparison of all 80 target entries and eight adjacent context rows. Tournament tiers, duplicate source titles, named hosts, consumable acronyms and preset distinctions were checked. Approved names unchanged.
uncertainties: Miyata Models is the approved project spelling; the source does not establish an official localized brand spelling.
Host ??? in row 588 is explicitly unknown in the source.
Consumable resistance names differ slightly from menu descriptions; corpus terminology normalization follows meaning review.

source_storage: Source text remains on the original disc; bind by inventory ID and SHA-256. Global order is 560 menu messages followed by other game records sorted by file offset.

notes.561: Miyata Models is the project romanization approved by the orchestrator. Host-name prefixes in tournament titles denote the source's hosting relationship. Official Rules matches use the same ruleset title as UI rows 335/346.
notes.564: Rows 564 and 565 are identical source titles; preserve the duplicate rather than infer a missing tier.
notes.566: Melee Tournament is distinct from Close Combat Match in row 573. Apply the UI ruleset distinction from rows 349 and 352.
notes.567: Retain the source Latin name McNET exactly. Rows 567-569 have identical source titles; do not invent identifying tier names.
notes.572: This title says energy-saving match, not tournament. Retain match to reflect the source distinction.
notes.575: Retain WMA without expanding its acronym. The orchestrator reports no verified expansion from external research.
notes.580: Rows 580-587 retain MH and source suffixes C/CW/B/BW/A/AW/S/SW. Do not invent expansions for MH or W.
notes.588: The host is deliberately shown as three question marks in the source. Preserve ??? rather than invent an organizer or silently omit it.
notes.593: Resistance is to electromagnetism generally. Do not narrow this to an electromagnetic pulse without evidence.
notes.594: Retain S/M/H labels for Ceramic Grease S and Titanium Grease M/H. No source expansion identifies these letters as softness or grades.
notes.597: LPR and HPR are source Latin gas labels. Retain the acronyms without speculative expansions.
notes.603: Power-Saving Set translates the source's electrical-power wording, distinct from the energy-saving tournament term.
notes.604: Enhanced Detection Set is the project term for improved enemy detection, not lock-on or marking range. Aligned with the following preset-name batch.
notes.607: Row 607 says Aerial Combat Set; later repetitions 615/623/631/639 explicitly say Enhanced Aerial Combat Set. Preserve this difference.
